message:
The other day, we found ourselves in a classic family group chat moment. We were discussing our emergency plans when someone casually mentioned, "Do we even know where the go-bags are?" 😅 It turned into a fun back-and-forth about our favorite snacks to pack and who was responsible for the important documents. 

What struck us was how this little conversation reminded us that preparedness doesn’t have to be a serious chore—it can actually be a bonding experience. 

It’s the simple reminders and shared laughs that keep us all connected and ready. What’s your favorite tip or trick for keeping your family in the loop about readiness?
